correction_reason: User clarified that var. and subsp. treatments can be synonymic or rank-shift representations of the same taxon in source lists. Therefore rank mismatch alone is not evidence for deletion or identity replacement.

local_evidence.source: User photographs, Actualización del catálogo de la flora vascular silvestre de La Rioja. Catálogo florístico, pp. 15-17; complete Herniaria block on p.16

corrected_decisions.reason: The exact variety name was not found by V8, but absence of an exact string does not show that the variety is taxonomically invalid or independent. POWO currently accepts Herniaria fruticosa subsp. fruticosa, so a rank/synonym relationship must be tested before mutation.

Herniaria glabra is accepted at species rank, but the variety-form string cannot be deleted solely because the current exact resolver did not return it. Synonymy/rank-equivalence must be checked first.

Rioja flora and the Spanish national pattern list support Herniaria scabrida subsp. scabrida, but the existing var. scabrida may represent a synonymic/rank-shift treatment rather than an erroneous identity. Preserve both source strings until the relationship is explicitly demonstrated.

general_rule.rule: Never delete, merge or replace a var./subsp. record solely because another source uses a different infraspecific rank or the base species. First establish the explicit synonymy or rank-equivalence chain from authoritative evidence. If equivalent, preserve all source names as synonyms/provenance and select the operative accepted treatment according to the active JBLR taxonomic naming policy. If equivalence is not demonstrated, retain as review-required.

powo_2026: Herniaria fruticosa subsp. fruticosa is accepted
Herniaria glabra is accepted at species rank
Herniaria scabrida is accepted at species rank
current_external_context.interpretation: These current treatments do not, by themselves, prove the exact status of the three V8 var. strings.

guards: var. and subsp. are rank markers, not spelling noise.
Different ranks can be taxonomic synonyms or alternative treatments.
Exact-string not-found is not absence and not invalidity.
Preserve original names, source, rank and synonym chain.
No downstream score inheritance across any eventual rank reconciliation without fresh execution.
